Utilize Super Lawyers to find an experienced personal injury attorney near you.
A personal injury attorney specializes in bringing lawsuits against negligent businesses or individuals on behalf of an injured party to seek damages.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: What is considered to be a personal injury?

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Personal injury in law is very broad and covers a wide spectrum of legal issues including injuries from car accidents, medical malpractice lawsuits, slip-and-fall, and dog bites / domestic animal attacks. Because personal injury is a civil law issue, it is concerned with liability and damages. Generally speaking, if someone harmed you in some way and they were at fault, you may be able to sue and collect monetary damages from the other party. Not all personal injuries require physical harm as certain cases of emotional distress and/or psychological suffering will also fit the criteria for a personal injury lawsuit.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: I was involved in an accident and suffered serious injuries. Do I have a claim for compensation?

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Whether your injuries qualify you for compensation will depend on many legal factors and facts specific to your case. As an injured victim where another party was to blame, a personal injury attorney can help you understand your options and ability to claim damages, mitigate medical bills, and alleviate suffering in your case. A successful personal injury claim will be able to prove 4 elements: duty, breach, causation, and damages. Did the responsible party have a duty to behave in a certain way? Did his/her failure to behave in that manner breach (violate) the duty owed to you? Was the resulting breach of duty the direct cause of the damage or harm/injury that you suffered? These are a few of the issues you'll need to be able to prove.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: What are the steps in a personal injury lawsuit?

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Prior to filing a personal injury lawsuit against another party, it's important to make the necessary preparations for a successful case. If you've been harmed or injured, get all needed medical treatment first. Be sure to carefully document all medical procedures and treatments and keep a copy of all medical paperwork pertinent to your claim. You'll want to connect with a personal injury attorney to bring suit against the party who injured you. From filing the claim to potentially representing you in court (if it goes to trial), a personal injury attorney will be a key ally in resolving your lawsuit.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Can I afford an attorney for my car accident injury or slip-and-fall?

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: If you were the victim of a slip-and-fall or injured in a car accident, you should seek out a personal injury attorney to protect your legal rights and get the financial compensation you deserve. Most personal injury attorneys work on contingency, meaning they only get paid if you win your case (or a settlement in your favor). Since you likely will be paying little to nothing out-of-pocket, the personal injury attorney you hire will likely be aggressive in advocating on your behalf, as your success is the means to their compensation. When attorneys work on contingency, their payment comes in the form of a percentage of the monetary damages awarded from the suit.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Are there any reputable personal injury lawyers near me?

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Finding a reputable lawyer to handle your case is important. There are many top-rated, highly-referred attorneys in your area who practice personal injury law. It's important to do your due diligence in order to find an attorney whom you are comfortable with and can best serve your needs. In your search for the right attorney, seek out counsel who have experience handling cases similar to yours.
